newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products rally on jump in futures.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products rally on jump in futures.

text.p: NWE oil products were higher across the board on Friday after a healthy rise in futures.
Gas oil firmed in line with futures in a quiet end-of-the-week market. Heating oil barges were quoted at July IPE +50 cents/+$1.0 fob ARA for second half June delivery.

High sulphur fuel oil barges rose in a quiet pre-weekend market to trade thrice at $87 a tonne fob Rotterdam after an earlier deal at $1 lower. Cargoes were quiet with two offers of bunker grade material at $79 and $81 fob.
Gasoline was steady on firm crude futures and further buying by one trader in the barges. Naphtha swaps rose with crude.
